title: Worktree publication preserves installation governance
summary: Keep exact approvals and charter authority at the verified installation while validating source in its worktree.
reusable_steps: Keep exact approvals and charter authority at the verified installation while validating source in its worktree
expected_outcome: Verify the shared Git common directory, preserve the complete source scope and body provenance, and route publication to one installation approval store. Never copy personal state or silently substitute missing roles. Missing role definitions require a separately reviewed additive digest-bound catalog migration. Preserve reviewed onboarding inputs with governed exclusive JSON creation. Scoped identity uncertainty becomes needs_attention; a standalone metadata diagnostic confirms installation readiness. Verify old-catalog refusal, real approval/resume, one publication effect and replay refusal. These checks cover public product behavior, not private organization policy.
